title: RealLab is a 32-bit Visual Basic 6 native (p-code) Windows GUI application
Two distinct builds of the main executable are present (V-ROOT-1.00 and v1.605)
VB6 project 'Real_lab_system': 212 objects, 8026 methods, 198 forms + 66 DataReports
Application is organised as per-domain result-entry forms and per-domain print DataReports
Dual database architecture: SQL Server is the system of record; Access/Jet MDBs are the offline/branch mirror
Third-party VB6 UI control packs and Microsoft OCX dependencies
Outbound integrations: SMTP e-mail, smsmisr.com SMS gateway, serial-port analysers
Shipped help is an Arabic (RTL) HTML Help 4.74 CHM with 17 topics and 79 images
Report layout is driven by 146 per-test INI files plus a 228-template RTF cache
Barcode and Arabic display fonts are shipped as first-party assets

Schema is a master/configuration core plus ~96 per-test 'profile' result tables
Naming trap: the Access table 'patients' is the OPERATOR/user account table, not patient demographics
Core master tables: patientinfo (demographics), patienttest (orders/results), testtable (catalogue), normalrange (ranges)
SQL access pattern: 1,337 ADO statements, SELECT-dominated with SHAPE hierarchies and DELETE maintenance
